verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack shows CrewAI offering input/output guardrails to validate, transform, or block unsafe content — docs describe agents, tasks, crews, flows, memory, tools, and enterprise features but never guardrail mechanisms. A competitor's comment (crewai-comm-4) even explicitly states CrewAI 'lacks' dial-able guardrails compared to their product, and a community critique (crewai-comm-2) notes CrewAI's example agent takes a 'destructive' default action without safety checks.
